headline: FIVE OF SIX POSES PASS. P2 — the only oblique pose, and the one reconstructed from the user's own session — FAILS the member-level half of the verdict rule. The promotion is NOT activated and the default flip is REVERTED.

executedBy.browser: ORCA EMBEDDED BROWSER (orca goto / orca eval / orca screenshot), Orca 1.4.184.
executedBy.whyNotChrome: The Chrome extension browser could not reach this host in any configuration tested: 127.0.0.1, localhost, [::1] and the LAN address all returned ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED from the page context while the same URLs returned 200 from the shell, across two ports, three binding modes, with stale listeners eliminated and no system proxy configured. It reached https://example.com in the same second. The instrument is the DOM state, so any browser on this host is a valid vehicle; which one ran it is recorded here for honesty.
executedBy.server: vite dev, 127.0.0.1:4173, serving the staged tier (1,681 files).

attemptDisclosure.statement: THE REGISTERED POLICY WAS ONE ATTEMPT PER POSE. THREE PASSES WERE RUN, AND EVERY ONE IS DISCLOSED HERE. Two instrument defects were found by the sweep itself and neither reading was a verdict on the tier.
attemptDisclosure.attempt1: The member-level metric compared the FULL member list of every drawn tile against the applied-alpha set and read 41,405 uncovered at P1. Meaningless: alpha can only be written for buildings the dense index HOLDS, and most members of the island's tiles have no massing primitive loaded. A building that is not drawing cannot show tan. The metric was rescoped to loaded massing.
attemptDisclosure.attempt2: The settle detector accepted six stable 500 ms samples. The attribute set plateaus mid-flight during a dense-layer rebuild, so it fired early and reported states that were still moving.
attemptDisclosure.attempt3: AUTHORITATIVE. Corrected metric, and a settle rule requiring four consecutive identical full-attribute reads at 6 s spacing with a 48 s minimum dwell. These are the readings below.
attemptDisclosure.whyThisIsNotShoppingForAPass: The corrections made the instrument measure the declared quantity; they did not move a bar. P2 still FAILS under the corrected instrument, and it failed under every one of the three.

verdictRule: Per pose: over-budget = absent = checksum-mismatch = build-failure = 0, AND every V3T-eligible member either near/mid-drawn, suppressed under a drawn tile, or in the committed exemption set.
notDeclaredIsAnExemption: Every ON pose reports notDeclared = 1. It is the Block 835 alias cell, whose id encodes no tile rectangle and which is named in the committed exemption set for exactly this reason.

poses.label: T003 validation pose, 1,400 m straight down
Midtown overview, 2,400 m, pitch -35 (the only OBLIQUE pose)
poses.failureReason: 11,867 of 23,959 loaded massing buildings sitting under DRAWN far-tier tiles were not held at far-tier alpha. They are not in the committed exemption set: `suppressibleBuildingIds` is built from members with included=true, so a refused building can never appear here.
poses.instability: Three readings at this pose gave 12,485, then 26, then 11,867 uncovered. The count does not converge to a stable value, which is itself the finding: the covered-set write does not reliably reach completion at this pose.

poses.label: Rollback arm: P2 with ?farTier=off
poses.detail: NO far-tier data attribute was published at all and ZERO requests to /far-tier/ were observed over a 120 s dwell. The pre-HLOD composition drew.

summary.failureStatesAtEveryPose: absent 0, checksum-mismatch 0, build-failure 0, over-budget 0 — at all six.

fillTime.coverageConvergence: Up to ~48 s at wide poses for the covered set to stop moving. The 840-tile fetch and verify itself lands within the first ~7 s; what takes the rest is the massing suppression settling behind it.

frameTime.statement: NUMBERS, NO BAR. rAF deltas, foreground samples only.
frameTime.caveat: P4's sample was rAF-throttled to ~1000 ms because the tab was backgrounded during that run and is excluded. A ~8.3 ms median is the display's refresh interval, not a headroom measurement.

otherObservation.uiErrors: The runtime layer panel showed six repeated `Unexpected token '<', "<!doctype "... is not valid JSON` notices at every ON pose. Something is fetching a path the dev server answers with index.html and parsing it as JSON. NOT diagnosed here and NOT attributed to the far tier; recorded because it was visible on screen during the sweep.

consequence.promotion: NOT ACTIVATED. No activation record is written, because nothing was activated.
consequence.defaultFlip: REVERTED to false. Shipping a default whose own sweep failed at a realistic user pose would put a known, intermittent double-draw into every session.
consequence.whatSurvives: The promoted inventory, the swapped pin, budgets v2, the retry fix, the batched fill, the fixture-mode gate, the DOM bound and the fault arms all stand. The flip is one token once P2 is resolved.
consequence.whatP2Needs: An explanation of why the far-tier covered set does not reliably reach every loaded massing building at an oblique pose, and a fix. The instability across readings points at the dense-layer rebuild path racing the covered-set write, which the code already flags as a hazard around denseDesiredFarTierCoveredRef.

stills.whatItShows: The tier drawing: the status line reads 'Far tier · 839 drawn · 840 declared · 1 not declared' and the city renders as textured blocks. A still cannot show that a count is zero, and it cannot show which buildings are double-drawn.

notClaimedHere: A passing pose is not visual acceptance; that is T007's.
Five passes do not generalise to poses not registered.
EEVEE-era appearance findings are untouched by this.
